THE PROBLEM

Why it matters

To-do lists grow, but nothing helps you actually start the most important task.

DESIGN APPROACH

Approach

Each card can launch a focus timer. The board limits "In progress" to three cards to fight multitasking.

Key features

  • 01Kanban board with WIP limit
  • 02Focus timer per task
  • 03Daily review
  • 04Keyboard shortcuts
